column1: # AUTHORED. Who GENERATED a BioProject, where the deposit-section heuristic cannot tell.
# screen_fulltext.py infers bioprojects_own from accessions appearing in a paper's data
# availability section. That is right for a paper reporting its own sequencing and wrong
# for one built on other people's: a browser or meta-analysis lists every accession it
# used in exactly the same place. 10.1186/s12864-021-07488-3, the Rust Expression Browser,
# claimed all nine it names and generated one, overstating its contribution by 531 runs.
# Rows here override that inference, in both directions. Evidence is the INSDC project
# record (submitting centre, submitter's study title, ENA-FIRST-PUBLIC) read against the
# paper's year, since data is deposited at or before publication and a paper years after
# the release cannot be the source. Gathered by retrieve/primary_papers.py; see
# data/silver/primary_papers_worklist.tsv in the research tree for the candidates each
# relation  generated   this paper produced the data
#           reanalysed  this paper used data someone else deposited
#           undecided   named by more than one plausible depositor, not yet resolved.
#                       Treated as reanalysed, so nothing is credited on a guess.
